scope: Future execution metadata and read-only upstream binding only; temporary synthetic tests and local Git fixtures. No live forecasting, workflow dispatch, collection, publication or production settings changed.

binding.newReports: event_commit matches initiating workflow event; source_commit is separately resolved actual Git HEAD and cross-checked with the forecast archive
binding.legacyReports: Reports without new identity fields retain the original source_commit-as-event fallback; archived values are never rewritten
binding.githubActions: Invalid event or unresolved code checkout aborts before readers, collectors, model import/execution, or output creation

limitations: The metadata is self-reported execution context, not an authenticated code attestation or external market-price validation.
Historical source_commit labels remain ambiguous as to actual checkout; no retrospective Git HEAD is invented.
No production automation or actual model collection was executed.
